The deck opens with a striking title slide establishing scope (1750–2024), then builds from the atmospheric CO₂ milestone through historical emission growth, national comparisons, and regional share shifts. 1	# Global CO₂ Emissions: Trends, Regional Shifts, and Per Capita Inequalities
2	
3	## Source
4	https://climate.nasa.gov/vital-signs/carbon-dioxide/ and Our World in Data — CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions (Global Carbon Budget 2025)
5	
6	## Atmospheric CO₂ Concentration
7	
8	The latest measurement from NOAA's Mauna Loa Observatory (February 2026) records atmospheric CO₂ at **429 parts per million (ppm)**. This represents a more than 50% increase from the pre-industrial baseline of approximately 280 ppm. The current level is at least 1.5 times greater than the natural increase observed at the end of the last ice age 20,000 years ago — a change that took thousands of years then but has occurred in roughly two centuries now. Ground-based and satellite measurements confirm the sharp acceleration, linked primarily to the burning of coal, oil, and natural gas.
9	
10	## Global Emissions Trajectory (1750–2024)
11	
12	Before the Industrial Revolution, CO₂ emissions were negligible. Growth remained relatively slow until the mid-20th century. In **1950**, the world emitted roughly **6 billion tonnes** of CO₂. By **1990**, emissions had nearly quadrupled to over **20 billion tonnes**. Today, global annual emissions from fossil fuels and industry exceed **35 billion tonnes**. While emissions growth has slowed in recent years, they have not yet peaked.
13	
14	![Annual CO₂ emissions by country](./assets/figure_3.jpg)
15	
16	## Who Emits the Most? Country-Level Totals
17	
18	China is the world's largest emitter by a significant margin, producing over 12 billion tonnes annually — more than one-quarter of the global total. The United States peaked near 6 billion tonnes around 2005 and has since declined to roughly 5 billion tonnes. India has risen rapidly to approximately 3 billion tonnes. Europe's share has fallen substantially.
19	
20	| Country / Region | Approx. Annual CO₂ (billion t) | Share of Global | Trend (recent) |
21	|---|---|---|---|
22	| China | ~12.5 | ~27% | Slight increase |
23	| United States | ~5.0 | ~14% | Declining |
24	| India | ~3.0 | ~8% | Rising |
25	| EU-27 | ~2.7 | ~7% | Declining |
26	| Germany | ~0.6 | ~1.7% | Declining |
27	| United Kingdom | ~0.3 | ~0.9% | Declining |
28	| Brazil | ~0.5 | ~1.4% | Roughly stable |
29	| France | ~0.3 | ~0.8% | Declining |
30	
31	In 1900, Europe and the US accounted for more than 90% of global emissions. By 1950, they still represented over 85%. Today, they account for less than one-third, while Asia — home to nearly 60% of the world's population — produces roughly half of all emissions. Africa and South America each contribute only 3–4%, comparable to international aviation and shipping combined.
32	
33	## Per Capita Emissions: Extreme Inequalities
34	
35	Per capita CO₂ emissions reveal stark global inequalities. The world's highest per capita emitters are major oil-producing nations with small populations (Qatar, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait). Among large, populous countries, the US, Australia, and Canada have per capita emissions roughly three times the global average.
36	
37	![Per capita CO₂ emissions over time](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
38	
39	| Country | Per Capita CO₂ (tonnes/year) |
40	|---|---|
41	| United States | ~15 |
42	| Canada | ~13 |
43	| Australia | ~15 |
44	| South Africa | ~8 |
45	| China | ~9 |
46	| EU-27 | ~7 |
47	| World average | ~5 |
48	| United Kingdom | ~4 |
49	| France | ~4 |
50	| India | ~2 |
51	| Kenya | <1 |
52	| Chad / Niger | ~0.1 |
53	
54	The gap between the highest and lowest per capita emitters is approximately **150-fold**: the average American or Australian emits in under two days what the average person in Chad or Niger emits in an entire year. Importantly, countries with similar living standards can differ significantly — France and the UK have much lower per capita emissions than Germany or the Netherlands, largely because of their energy mix (higher nuclear and renewable shares).
55

## Source
https://climate.nasa.gov/vital-signs/carbon-dioxide/ and Our World in Data — CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions (Global Carbon Budget 2025)

## Atmospheric CO₂ Concentration

The latest measurement from NOAA's Mauna Loa Observatory (February 2026) records atmospheric CO₂ at **429 parts per million (ppm)**. ## Global Emissions Trajectory (1750–2024)

Before the Industrial Revolution, CO₂ emissions were negligible. Growth remained relatively slow until the mid-20th century. In **1950**, the world emitted roughly **6 billion tonnes** of CO₂. By **1990**, emissions had nearly quadrupled to over **20 billion tonnes**. Today, global annual emissions from fossil fuels and industry exceed **35 billion tonnes**. While emissions growth has slowed in recent years, they have not yet peaked.

![Annual CO₂ emissions by country](./assets/figure_3.jpg)

## Who Emits the Most? Country-Level Totals

China is the world's largest emitter by a significant margin, producing over 12 billion tonnes annually — more than one-quarter of the global total. The United States peaked near 6 billion tonnes around 2005 and has since declined to roughly 5 billion tonnes. India has risen rapidly to approximately 3 billion tonnes. Europe's share has fallen substantially.

| India | ~3.0 | ~8% | Rising |
| EU-27 | ~2.7 | ~7% | Declining |
| Germany | ~0.6 | ~1.7% | Declining |
| United Kingdom | ~0.3 | ~0.9% | Declining |
| Brazil | ~0.5 | ~1.4% | Roughly stable |
| France | ~0.3 | ~0.8% | Declining |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Global CO₂ Emissions presentation as PPTX."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
import os

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — authoritative, data-forward
DARK_BG = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x17, 0x2A)
MEDIUM_BG = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1E, 0x33)
CARD_BG = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x26, 0x3E)
ACCENT = RGBColor(0x00, 0xA8, 0xE8)
ACCENT2 = RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA)
ACCENT_WARM = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x35)
ACCENT_RED = RGBColor(0xE8, 0x3E, 0x3E)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xB0, 0xBC, 0xD0)
MID_GRAY = RGBColor(0x6B, 0x7B, 0x93)
HIGHLIGHT = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD6, 0x00)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def add_bg(slide, color=DARK_BG):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    if alpha is not None:
        from lxml import etree
        solidFill = shape.fill._fill
        srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}srgbClr')
        if srgb is None:
            srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}schemeClr')
        if srgb is not None:
            nsmap = {'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}
            alpha_el = etree.SubElement(srgb, '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}alpha')
            alpha_el.set('val', str(int(alpha * 1000)))
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE,
                bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multiline_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16,
                          default_color=LIGHT_GRAY, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_spec in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        text = line_spec.get("text", "")
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(line_spec.get("size", default_size))
        p.font.color.rgb = line_spec.get("color", default_color)
        p.font.bold = line_spec.get("bold", False)
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.alignment = line_spec.get("align", PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
        if "space_before" in line_spec:
            p.space_before = Pt(line_spec["space_before"])
        if "space_after" in line_spec:
            p.space_after = Pt(line_spec["space_after"])
    return txBox


def add_stat_card(slide, left, top, width, height, number, label, accent=ACCENT):
    add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, CARD_BG)
    add_rect(slide, left, top, Inches(0.06), height, accent)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.25), top + Inches(0.15), width - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.7),
                number, font_size=32, color=accent, bold=True)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.25), top + Inches(0.75), width - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.5),
                label, font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


def add_horiz_bar(slide, left, top, bar_width_max, bar_height, label, value, max_val,
                  bar_color=ACCENT, label_width=Inches(1.5)):
    add_textbox(slide, left, top, label_width, bar_height, label,
                font_size=12, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    bar_left = left + label_width + Inches(0.1)
    ratio = value / max_val
    bw = int(bar_width_max * ratio)
    if bw < Inches(0.15):
        bw = Inches(0.15)
    add_rect(slide, bar_left, top + Inches(0.02), bw, bar_height - Inches(0.04), bar_color)
    add_textbox(slide, bar_left + bw + Inches(0.08), top, Inches(0.8), bar_height,
                f"{value}", font_size=11, color=WHITE, bold=True)


def add_thin_line(slide, left, top, width, color=MID_GRAY):
    add_rect(slide, left, top, width, Inches(0.015), color)


# ─── SLIDE 1: Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)

# Decorative accent bar at top
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.08), ACCENT)

# Main title
add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.5), Inches(11.5), Inches(3.0), [
    {"text": "Global CO\u2082 Emissions", "size": 48, "color": WHITE, "bold": True, "space_after": 4},
    {"text": "Trends, Regional Shifts, and Per Capita Inequalities", "size": 30, "color": ACCENT, "bold": False, "space_before": 4},
])

add_thin_line(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.3), Inches(3.5), ACCENT)

add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.6), Inches(8), Inches(1.2), [
    {"text": "1750 \u2013 2024  |  Fossil Fuels & Industry", "size": 18, "color": LIGHT_GRAY},
    {"text": "Data: Global Carbon Budget 2025  |  NASA / NOAA Mauna Loa Observatory", "size": 14, "color": MID_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
])

# Stat badges on right
add_stat_card(slide, Inches(9.5), Inches(4.8), Inches(3.2), Inches(1.1),
              "429 ppm", "Atmospheric CO\u2082 (Feb 2026)", ACCENT)
add_stat_card(slide, Inches(9.5), Inches(6.1), Inches(3.2), Inches(1.1),
              "35+ Bt/yr", "Global Fossil CO\u2082 Emissions", ACCENT_WARM)


# ─── SLIDE 2: Atmospheric CO₂ Milestone ──────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), ACCENT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "ATMOSPHERIC CO\u2082 MILESTONE", font_size=12, color=ACCENT, bold=True)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.7), Inches(11), Inches(1.0),
            "Atmospheric CO\u2082 Reaches 429 ppm \u2014 50% Above Pre-Industrial Levels",
            font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Big number callout
add_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(5.5), Inches(3.5), CARD_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(0.08), Inches(3.5), ACCENT)

add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(2.2), Inches(4.8), Inches(3.2), [
    {"text": "429", "size": 80, "color": ACCENT, "bold": True},
    {"text": "parts per million (Feb 2026)", "size": 18, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 0},
    {"text": "", "size": 10, "color": LIGHT_GRAY},
    {"text": "Pre-industrial baseline: ~280 ppm", "size": 16, "color": MID_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
    {"text": "+53% increase in ~200 years", "size": 16, "color": ACCENT_WARM, "bold": True, "space_before": 6},
])

# Timeline context on right
add_rect(slide, Inches(6.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(5.8), Inches(3.5), CARD_BG)

add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(7.2), Inches(2.3), Inches(5.0), Inches(3.0), [
    {"text": "Context & Acceleration", "size": 18, "color": WHITE, "bold": True, "space_after": 8},
    {"text": "\u25B8  At least 1.5\u00d7 greater than the natural increase observed at the end of the last ice age 20,000 years ago",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
    {"text": "\u25B8  That natural change took thousands of years; this one has occurred in roughly two centuries",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Driven primarily by burning coal, oil, and natural gas",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Confirmed by both ground-based and satellite measurements",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 8},
])

# Bottom bar with source
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.8), Inches(10), Inches(0.4),
            "Source: NOAA Mauna Loa Observatory, NASA", font_size=11, color=MID_GRAY)


# ─── SLIDE 3: Global Emissions Trajectory ────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), ACCENT_WARM)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "EMISSIONS TRAJECTORY", font_size=12, color=ACCENT_WARM, bold=True)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.7), Inches(11), Inches(1.0),
            "Global Fossil Fuel CO\u2082 Emissions Grew Six-Fold Since 1950",
            font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Three milestone stat cards
card_w = Inches(3.5)
card_h = Inches(1.5)
y = Inches(2.0)

milestones = [
    ("6 Bt", "1950", ACCENT),
    ("20 Bt", "1990", ACCENT2),
    ("35+ Bt", "2024", ACCENT_WARM),
]
for i, (val, year, clr) in enumerate(milestones):
    x = Inches(0.8) + i * (card_w + Inches(0.4))
    add_stat_card(slide, x, y, card_w, card_h, val, f"Annual CO\u2082 Emissions \u2014 {year}", clr)

# Connecting arrows
for i in range(2):
    ax = Inches(0.8) + (i + 1) * (card_w + Inches(0.4)) - Inches(0.25)
    add_textbox(slide, ax, y + Inches(0.4), Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5),
                "\u25B6", font_size=24, color=MID_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Description area
add_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.0), Inches(7.0), Inches(2.8), CARD_BG)
add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(4.2), Inches(6.3), Inches(2.4), [
    {"text": "Key Trajectory Points", "size": 18, "color": WHITE, "bold": True, "space_after": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Pre-Industrial Revolution: CO\u2082 emissions were negligible",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Growth remained relatively slow until mid-20th century",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Emissions nearly quadrupled from 1950 to 1990",
     "size": 14, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Growth has slowed in recent years, but emissions have not yet peaked",
     "size": 14, "color": ACCENT_WARM, "bold": True, "space_before": 6},
])

# Figure reference
fig3_path = os.path.join(ASSETS, "figure_3.jpg")
if os.path.exists(fig3_path):
    slide.shapes.add_picture(fig3_path, Inches(8.3), Inches(3.9), Inches(4.5), Inches(3.0))

add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(6.95), Inches(4.5), Inches(0.3),
            "Figure: Annual CO\u2082 emissions by country", font_size=10, color=MID_GRAY)


# ─── SLIDE 4: Country-Level Totals ───────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), ACCENT_RED)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "NATIONAL COMPARISONS", font_size=12, color=ACCENT_RED, bold=True)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.7), Inches(11), Inches(1.0),
            "China Now Emits Over 12 Billion Tonnes \u2014 More Than Double the United States",
            font_size=28, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Bar chart area — horizontal bars
countries_data = [
    ("China", 12.5, "~27%", ACCENT_RED),
    ("United States", 5.0, "~14%", ACCENT),
    ("India", 3.0, "~8%", ACCENT_WARM),
    ("EU-27", 2.7, "~7%", ACCENT2),
    ("Germany", 0.6, "~1.7%", MID_GRAY),
    ("Brazil", 0.5, "~1.4%", MID_GRAY),
    ("UK", 0.3, "~0.9%", MID_GRAY),
    ("France", 0.3, "~0.8%", MID_GRAY),
]

bar_top_start = Inches(1.8)
bar_h = Inches(0.45)
bar_max_w = Inches(5.5)
max_val = 12.5

for i, (country, val, share, clr) in enumerate(countries_data):
    y_pos = bar_top_start + i * (bar_h + Inches(0.12))
    add_horiz_bar(slide, Inches(0.5), y_pos, bar_max_w, bar_h,
                  country, val, max_val, clr, label_width=Inches(1.6))
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.5) + Inches(1.6) + Inches(0.1) + int(bar_max_w * val / max_val) + Inches(1.0),
                y_pos, Inches(0.8), bar_h,
                share, font_size=10, color=MID_GRAY)

# Trend annotations on right
add_rect(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(4.3), Inches(5.2), CARD_BG)
add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(8.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(3.8), Inches(5.0), [
    {"text": "Trends (Recent)", "size": 18, "color": WHITE, "bold": True, "space_after": 10},
    {"text": "China  ~12.5 Bt", "size": 14, "color": ACCENT_RED, "bold": True, "space_before": 8},
    {"text": "Slight increase, >25% of global total", "size": 12, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 2},
    {"text": "United States  ~5.0 Bt", "size": 14, "color": ACCENT, "bold": True, "space_before": 10},
    {"text": "Declining from ~6 Bt peak (c. 2005)", "size": 12, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 2},
    {"text": "India  ~3.0 Bt", "size": 14, "color": ACCENT_WARM, "bold": True, "space_before": 10},
    {"text": "Rising rapidly, 3rd largest emitter", "size": 12, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 2},
    {"text": "EU-27  ~2.7 Bt", "size": 14, "color": ACCENT2, "bold": True, "space_before": 10},
    {"text": "Declining, share fallen substantially", "size": 12, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 2},
])

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(7.0), Inches(6), Inches(0.3),
            "Values in billion tonnes CO\u2082/year  |  Source: Global Carbon Budget 2025",
            font_size=10, color=MID_GRAY)


# ─── SLIDE 5: Regional Share Shift ───────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), ACCENT2)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "REGIONAL SHIFT", font_size=12, color=ACCENT2, bold=True)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.7), Inches(11), Inches(1.0),
            "Asia Now Accounts for ~50% of Global Emissions; US + Europe Below One-Third",
            font_size=28, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Side-by-side comparison: 1900 vs 2024
# 1900 panel
panel_w = Inches(5.5)
panel_h = Inches(4.2)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.9), panel_w, panel_h, CARD_BG)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.1), Inches(2.1), Inches(3), Inches(0.5),
            "1900", font_size=36, color=ACCENT, bold=True)

# Stacked bar representation for 1900
bar_y_1900 = Inches(2.8)
bar_full_w = Inches(4.8)
# Europe+US >90%
eu_us_w = int(bar_full_w * 0.90)
rest_w = int(bar_full_w * 0.10)
add_rect(slide, Inches(1.1), bar_y_1900, eu_us_w, Inches(0.7), ACCENT)
add_rect(slide, Inches(1.1) + eu_us_w, bar_y_1900, rest_w, Inches(0.7), MID_GRAY)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.1), bar_y_1900 + Inches(0.05), eu_us_w, Inches(0.6),
            "Europe + US: >90%", font_size=14, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(1.1), Inches(3.7), Inches(4.8), Inches(2.2), [
    {"text": "\u25B8  Europe and the US dominated global emissions", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Rest of world: <10%", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Asia, Africa, South America negligible", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
])

# Arrow between panels
add_textbox(slide, Inches(6.3), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.8),
            "\u25B6", font_size=36, color=ACCENT2, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# 2024 panel
add_rect(slide, Inches(7.0), Inches(1.9), panel_w, panel_h, CARD_BG)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(7.3), Inches(2.1), Inches(3), Inches(0.5),
            "2024", font_size=36, color=ACCENT_WARM, bold=True)

# Stacked bar for 2024
bar_y_2024 = Inches(2.8)
asia_w = int(bar_full_w * 0.50)
eu_us_w_2024 = int(bar_full_w * 0.30)
other_w = int(bar_full_w * 0.20)
add_rect(slide, Inches(7.3), bar_y_2024, asia_w, Inches(0.7), ACCENT_WARM)
add_rect(slide, Inches(7.3) + asia_w, bar_y_2024, eu_us_w_2024, Inches(0.7), ACCENT)
add_rect(slide, Inches(7.3) + asia_w + eu_us_w_2024, bar_y_2024, other_w, Inches(0.7), MID_GRAY)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(7.3), bar_y_2024 + Inches(0.05), asia_w, Inches(0.6),
            "Asia ~50%", font_size=13, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(7.3) + asia_w, bar_y_2024 + Inches(0.05), eu_us_w_2024, Inches(0.6),
            "US+EU <33%", font_size=11, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_multiline_textbox(slide, Inches(7.3), Inches(3.7), Inches(4.8), Inches(2.2), [
    {"text": "\u25B8  Asia: ~50% (home to ~60% of world population)", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  US + Europe: <33% combined", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Africa & South America: 3\u20134% each", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
    {"text": "\u25B8  Similar to international aviation & shipping", "size": 13, "color": LIGHT_GRAY, "space_before": 6},
])

# 1950 midpoint callout
add_rect(slide, Inches(3.5), Inches(6.4), Inches(6.5), Inches(0.8), CARD_BG)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(3.7), Inches(6.5), Inches(6.0), Inches(0.5),
            "By 1950, Europe + US still represented over 85% of global emissions",
            font_size=13, color=HIGHLIGHT, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


# ─── SLIDE 6: Per Capita 150× Gap ────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
add_rect(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.06), ACCENT_WARM)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "PER CAPITA INEQUALITIES", font_size=12, color=ACCENT_WARM, bold=True)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.7), Inches(11), Inches(1.0),
            "Per Capita Gap: 15 t in the US vs. 0.1 t in Chad \u2014 a 150\u00d7 Disparity",
            font_size=28, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Horizontal bar chart
per_capita_data = [
    ("United States", 15, ACCENT_RED),
    ("Canada", 13, ACCENT_RED),
    ("China", 9, ACCENT_WARM),
    ("EU-27", 7, ACCENT),
    ("World average", 5, ACCENT2),
    ("United Kingdom", 4, ACCENT2),
    ("India", 2, RGBColor(0x5B, 0x9B, 0xD5)),
    ("Kenya", 0.8, MID_GRAY),
    ("Chad", 0.1, MID_GRAY),
]

bar_start_y = Inches(1.8)
bar_h = Inches(0.48)
bar_spacing = Inches(0.1)
bar_max_w_px = Inches(7.0)
max_val_pc = 15

for i, (country, val, clr) in enumerate(per_capita_data):
    y_pos = bar_start_y + i * (bar_h + bar_spacing)
    # Country label
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.3), y_pos, Inches(1.8), bar_h, country,
                font_size=12, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    # Bar
    bar_left = Inches(2.2)
    ratio = val / max_val_pc
    bw = int(bar_max_w_px * ratio)
    if bw < Inches(0.1):
        bw = Inches(0.1)
    add_rect(slide, bar_left, y_pos + Inches(0.04), bw, bar_h - Inches(0.08), clr)
    # Value label
    display_val = f"~{val} t" if val >= 1 else f"~{val} t" if val > 0.5 else f"~{val} t"
    if country == "Kenya":
        display_val = "<1 t"

SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

HIGHLIGHT = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD6, 0x00)

prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def add_bg(slide, color=DARK_BG):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    if alpha is not None:
        from lxml import etree
        solidFill = shape.fill._fill
        srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}srgbClr')
        if srgb is None:
            srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}schemeClr')
        if srgb is not None:
            nsmap = {'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}
            alpha_el = etree.SubElement(srgb, '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}alpha')
            alpha_el.set('val', str(int(alpha * 1000)))
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE,
                bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multiline_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16,
                          default_color=LIGHT_GRAY, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_spec in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        text = line_spec.get("text", "")
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(line_spec.get("size", default_size))
        p.font.color.rgb = line_spec.get("color", default_color)
        p.font.bold = line_spec.get("bold", False)
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.alignment = line_spec.get("align", PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
        if "space_before" in line_spec:
            p.space_before = Pt(line_spec["space_before"])
        if "space_after" in line_spec:

    return txBox

                label, font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)

    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill

    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    if alpha is not None:
        from lxml import etree
        solidFill = shape.fill._fill
        srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}srgbClr')
        if srgb is None:
            srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}schemeClr')
        if srgb is not None:
            nsmap = {'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}

            alpha_el.set('val', str(int(alpha * 1000)))
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE,
                bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multiline_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16,
                          default_color=LIGHT_GRAY, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_spec in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        text = line_spec.get("text", "")
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(line_spec.get("size", default_size))
        p.font.color.rgb = line_spec.get("color", default_color)
        p.font.bold = line_spec.get("bold", False)
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.alignment = line_spec.get("align", PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
        if "space_before" in line_spec:
            p.space_before = Pt(line_spec["space_before"])
        if "space_after" in line_spec:
            p.space_after = Pt(line_spec["space_after"])
    return txBox

def add_bg(slide, color=DARK_BG):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    if alpha is not None:
        from lxml import etree
        solidFill = shape.fill._fill
        srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}srgbClr')
        if srgb is None:
            srgb = solidFill.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}schemeClr')
        if srgb is not None:
            nsmap = {'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}
            alpha_el = etree.SubElement(srgb, '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}alpha')
            alpha_el.set('val', str(int(alpha * 1000)))
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE,
                bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multiline_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16,
                          default_color=LIGHT_GRAY, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_spec in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        text = line_spec.get("text", "")
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(line_spec.get("size", default_size))
        p.font.color.rgb = line_spec.get("color", default_color)
        p.font.bold = line_spec.get("bold", False)
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.alignment = line_spec.get("align", PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
        if "space_before" in line_spec:
            p.space_before = Pt(line_spec["space_before"])
        if "space_after" in line_spec:
            p.space_after = Pt(line_spec["space_after"])
    return txBox


def add_stat_card(slide, left, top, width, height, number, label, accent=ACCENT):
    add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, CARD_BG)
    add_rect(slide, left, top, Inches(0.06), height, accent)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.25), top + Inches(0.15), width - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.7),
                number, font_size=32, color=accent, bold=True)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.25), top + Inches(0.75), width - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.5),
                label, font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


def add_horiz_bar(slide, left, top, bar_width_max, bar_height, label, value, max_val,
                  bar_color=ACCENT, label_width=Inches(1.5)):
    add_textbox(slide, left, top, label_width, bar_height, label,
                font_size=12, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    bar_left = left + label_width + Inches(0.1)
    ratio = value / max_val
    bw = int(bar_width_max * ratio)
    if bw < Inches(0.15):
        bw = Inches(0.15)
    add_rect(slide, bar_left, top + Inches(0.02), bw, bar_height - Inches(0.04), bar_color)
    add_textbox(slide, bar_left + bw + Inches(0.08), top, Inches(0.8), bar_height,
                f"{value}", font_size=11, color=WHITE, bold=True)


def add_thin_line(slide, left, top, width, color=MID_GRAY):
